name: Stream Highlights
author: Mutant Video Producer
description: Finds the moments of a stream recording where the chat went busiest and cuts them, in order, into a highlight reel at the end of the edit. The chat log can be a text file with a time on each line ("[1:02:03] name: message" or "1:02:03 ..."), a CSV with the seconds first, or a Twitch chat JSON (comments with content_offset_seconds).

fields.label: Start this many seconds before the busiest moment
Chat is ahead of the video by (seconds)
